## Reading first

A pigment-inspired palette rooted in *Moby-Dick*. Warm paper, deep ink,
eight accent hues named after the crew of the *Pequod*.

> Call me Ishmael.

## A little code

```python
def loss(theta, x, y):
    """Mean squared error for a linear model."""
    return ((x @ theta - y) ** 2).mean()
```

Inline code like `loss(theta, x, y)` also picks up the Pequod register.
